# Replace the battery

[All care guides](README.md)

## Roomba 600 and 700 series · Roomba 800 and 900 series

![Replace the battery](../img/underside_600_900--battery.svg)

**What it does**

A battery loses capacity with every charge. The robot then runs for less time and may stop before it has finished.

**How to**

1. Switch the robot off and turn it over.
2. Undo the screws of the battery cover and lift the cover off.
3. Pull the old battery out by its tabs and insert the new one with the contacts facing the same way.
4. Fit the cover, set the robot on the dock and mark the battery as replaced.

> **Note** Use a battery made for this model, and take the old one to a battery collection point.
